Title: Anil's Day

Cast

1. Anil - 32 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Shalini - 64 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Sonali - 28 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
4. Anjali - 31 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
5. Nitin - 42 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Anil stands in the court. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Anil sits down on the throne.]

Anil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Anil unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Anil: "Really?"

[Anil drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Shalini (excited): "Rest in peace."
